name: LaTeX papers
description: Write, build and check an academic paper in LaTeX. The build and the check run in a scratch COPY of the project (so no .aux, .log or .pdf litters your folder), pick the engine from the preamble (pdflatex, or lualatex for Unicode-font papers (Arabic, Hebrew, CJK, ...)), run bibtex and as many passes as the cross-references need, and read the log for you: errors with file and line, undefined references and citations, lines that run into the margin, and a missing TeX package named with the apt package to install. TeX runs with file access restricted to the project and shell escape off, so a paper from somewhere else cannot read your files or run commands. The bibliography check compares the citation keys with the .bib files. Give the main .tex file, or the project folder. Needs a TeX Live (texlive-latex-base at least; texlive-latex-recommended and -extra for most real papers; latexmk and biber are not used).

packages.apt: php-cli php-mbstring texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended texlive-luatex texlive-bibtex-extra pandoc

presets.label: Check (build and read the log)
presets.description: Builds the paper in a scratch copy and reports: errors as file(line), undefined references and citations, lines more than 10 pt too wide, missing characters in the font, a missing TeX package with the apt package to install, and the engine and passes used. With Fix with agent.

presets.label: Build the PDF
presets.description: Compiles the paper to a PDF (engine from the preamble, bibtex, enough passes) in a scratch copy: the project folder is not written to. If it fails, the first errors are shown and no PDF is made.

presets.label: Check the bibliography
presets.description: Compares the citation keys used in the .tex files with the .bib files: a citation with no entry (error), a key defined twice (error), an entry with no author, title or year (warning), an entry that is never cited (note).

presets.label: Word count (text only)
presets.description: The number of words in the text, by section, without maths, commands or the bibliography (pandoc reads the LaTeX).

presets.label: New paper (article + bibliography)
presets.description: Creates a paper in a subfolder of the folder you give: main.tex (article, equations, natbib) and refs.bib. Type the paper's name in the extra arguments (letters, digits, - and _). Never overwrites. Builds with only texlive-latex-base.

presets.label: LaTeX to Word (.docx) for co-authors
presets.description: Converts the paper to a Word document with pandoc, to send to a co-author who does not use LaTeX. Equations become Word equations; the layout is pandoc's, not the journal's.

presets.label: Markdown to LaTeX (.tex)
presets.description: Converts a markdown draft to a standalone LaTeX article with pandoc, as a start for the paper.
